name: Collective attribution
description: Attributing individual actions to an entire group

name: Manufactured consensus
description: Creating the false impression of widespread agreement

name: Essentialization
description: Treating a diverse group as culturally monolithic

name: Conspiratorial intent
description: Attributing hidden malicious intent to ordinary behavior

description: Claiming that those fighting discrimination are the real aggressors

name: Slippery slope
description: Claiming that a current situation inevitably leads to an extreme outcome
